summary: Official acknowledgement letter from the State of California Department of Consumer Affairs Board of Registered Nursing (BRN) dated June 22, 2026, confirming receipt and active Enforcement Division evaluation of the formal complaint filed by Nicolas Hernandez against practitioner Dr. Kenneth Emeka Ezenwa under Enforcement Complaint No. 4002026009197.
full_text:
CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER AFFAIRS
BOARD OF REGISTERED NURSING
1747 N. Market Blvd. Suite 150, Sacramento, CA 95834
P (916) 322-3350 F (916) 574-8637 | www.rn.ca.gov

June 22, 2026

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ
EMAILED TO: [Redacted Email]

RE: DR. KENNETH EMEKA EZENWA

Dear NICOLAS HERNANDEZ:

This is in response to the information that has been provided to the Board of Registered Nursing.

We are carefully evaluating this matter and appropriate action will be taken. It is important that the BRN Enforcement Division staff is able to keep in contact with you. If the address you provided as a contact changes, please notify the Enforcement Division as soon as possible in writing to:

Board of Registered Nursing
Attn: Enforcement Division
P.O. Box 944210
Sacramento, CA 94244-2100

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention and the opportunity to be of assistance.

Sincerely,

BOARD OF REGISTERED NURSING

Complaint No. 4002026009197

400. CMPLREC1.040218
